Details
The scheme “Mukhya Mantri Hamari Betiyan Yojana”, launched by the Education (Elementary and Secondary) Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to promote and support meritorious girl students by providing financial assistance and recognition to those who have secured top positions in the Class 10 Board Examination.
Benefits
Financial Reward: Eligible girl students receive incentives as per the norms.
Eligibility
The applicant must be a native of Rajasthan.
The applicant must be a girl student.
The applicant must have secured the first or second position in the Class 10 Board Examination conducted by the Ajmer Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan, at the district level.
The applicant must be studying in Class 11 at the time of application.
Only two girl students from each district are eligible for the scheme.
The applicant must have secured a minimum of 75% marks in the Class 10 examination.
Application Process
Offline
 Please contact your school.
Documents Required
1. Aadhaar card.
2. Class 10th marksheet.
3. Bank account details.
4. Passport-size photo.
5. Bhamashah card.
6. Caste certificate.
